options.name: no_change
options.action: Do not retrain or alter inference until benchmark calibration is sufficient.

options.name: inference_fix
options.action: Do not change state/action preprocessing without a positive-control or differential diagnosis.

options.name: minimal_training_fix
options.action: Do not launch a repair training run while the evaluator itself lacks a known-good positive control.

options.name: full_retrain
options.action: Do not start a full retrain; it would confound protocol and model effects.

next_gate: Recover the historical evaluator/runtime or obtain a checkpoint known to succeed under the exact benchmark-v1 initialization and preprocessing. The historical 010000 candidate was tested on five benchmark initializations and yielded 0/5, so it is not a positive control. Do not select an intervention until a positive control exists.
